text: The purpose of this report is to provide information on the Purchase of Service contracts awarded and executed by the Medical Officer of Health for 2019, according to the delegation of authority by City Council.

City Council on May 14 and 15, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the Medical Officer of Health to award, execute, and amend the Purchase of Service contract for the 2019 Community Food Works Program, as outlined in Appendix E to the report (April 18, 2019) from the Medical Officer of Health, within the approved budget and in accordance with established provincial criteria and fee structures.
